data.long_meaning: The name Nashir is derived from the Arabic word ‘nashara’ which means to announce, to make known, and to proclaim. The name Nashir carries the meaning “Announcer, Messenger” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nashir usually hope their child will grow to embody announcer, messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
